bf16-bs1.note: Nsight node tracing perturbs timing. Graph gap includes sampling/allocator/encoding GPU work and CPU gaps; it is not all CPU overhead. GPU busy union combines kernel and memcpy activities; it is not E2E request time.
bf16-bs1.nongraph_note: Nsight stores graphId=NULL outside graphs; offgraph = all kernels minus graph kernels, including prefill.
